items.name: Yeast infection means thick, odorless discharge
BV means thin discharge with a fishy smell
Itching means yeast, smell means BV
Don't keep buying antifungal cream blindly

closing.headline: Don't just grab antifungal cream for unusual discharge — check which one it is.
closing.tip: Check the discharge texture, smell, and how intense the itching is.
closing.cta: See an OB-GYN if symptoms keep recurring or it's unclear.
